required_outcomes: Records that the landlord is using his own contractor (his handyman Dev), quoting his reply.

Tells the tenant (Clara) that the landlord's handyman Dev will text her to arrange a visit, and that the landlord expects Friday 18 September in the afternoon, without presenting it as an appointment the agency has booked.
Sets a review date after Friday 18 September (for example Monday 21 September) to confirm with the landlord or tenant that the fan was looked at and works.
acceptable_alternatives: Replying to the landlord to acknowledge and ask him to let the agency know once Dev has been.
Putting the job on hold with the reason "landlord's own contractor" and a review date instead of a follow-up task.
positive_behaviours: Tells the tenant she can let the agency know if the time Dev suggests does not suit or nobody gets in touch.
red_flags: Asking the landlord for the contractor's name and date he has already given.
prohibited_actions: Assigning the agency's contractor or returning the ticket to provider selection, so the job could be done twice.
Closing the request before anyone confirms the fan works.
critical_failures: Sending an agency contractor as well as the landlord's handyman.
